name: Rough Harvester Ant
desc: Rough Harvester Ant (Pogonomyrmex rugosus): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 1 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Pogonomyrmex rugosus, the desert harvester ant or rough harvester ant, is a species of harvester ant in the subfamily Myrmicinae which is found in the southwestern United States,and Northern Mexico.
